cd.title: Feedback Summer
cd.situation: The Static are playing outside the shop, but their battery amp keeps dying mid-chorus.
cd.today: The Static's 'Feedback Summer' went gold. Fans still leave guitar picks on the shop's windowsill.

actions.label: plugged The Static's amp into the shop
actions.line: You run the reel to the shop's outdoor socket. The amp hums, then ROARS. The drummer gives you a thumbs up.

actions.label: handed them the shop's microphone
actions.line: Their mic was held together with tape. Yours works. The whole street stops, packs in round the stage and sings the chorus back.
actions.lockedLine: A good mic won't help while their amp keeps dying. They need power first.

offline.headline: Plugged-In Street Gig Makes The Static Stars
offline.article: In July 2004 The Static borrowed Hollow Records' socket and microphone, and a passing crowd filmed the whole set. 'Feedback Summer' sold out within a month, and its gold disc now hangs in the shop.
